find_receptacles: find all receptacles defined in the scene metadata for currently instanced rigid and articulated objects
parse_receptacles_from_user_config: parse receptacle metadata from a user subconfig and construct AABBReceptacle or TriangleMeshReceptacle objects
import_tri_mesh: import triangle mesh data from a mesh file using magnum trade importer and return MeshData objects
get_navigable_receptacles: filter a list of receptacles to return only those navigable from the largest indoor navmesh island
ReceptacleTracker_allocate_one_placement: allocate one object placement to a receptacle and decrement its remaining allocation counter
